doctrine: The Direction Shift is a 6-week, 30-post content campaign for SNIPED Media designed to shift from portfolio-only (100% craft/client work) to story-driven posting. The framework pivots on 6 pillars: Origin (personal founding narrative: robbery, one light in Clemson apartment, 2019 camera recovery), Craft (BTS, editing evolution, one-light setups), Campaign (Mother's Day + Grad promos with urgency), Client Work (delivered frames with context), Social Proof (early-career models who blew up: Amber Lynn 158K followers, Tally Spencer in media), Personal Reveal (hair transplant Turkey trip, credit score drop from 721 to under 600, cancelled wedding). The Shift succeeds when pillars 1, 5, 6 comprise 50% of feed (currently 0%). Execution: Post 1 launches as reel Sunday-Monday 7-9pm PT (voiceover across camera close-up, Clemson apartment one-light setup, studio evolution, 34-40s duration). Posts 2-30 follow 6-week release schedule (weekday posts 10am-noon or 7-9pm PT; weekend Saturday 3-6pm, Sunday 8-10pm). No hashtags on shift posts (frame-setters, not discovery). Reply to every comment on posts 1-5 to train engagement. Pin strategy: post 1 for weeks 1-3, strongest performer weeks 4-6, post 30 thereafter. Campaign cadence: Mother's Day (posts 2, 6, 11, 12) May 2-3 launch (12 spots, $275/'The Moment', $550/'The Feature'). Grad season (posts 14, 15, 16, 19, 23, 27, 29) launched post-MD. Post-MD flyer lives in stories/ads/DMs only (not feed). Archive reuse: every shoot since 2018 is tagged in Lightroom with pull dates. Spec campaigns (2 hero concepts minimum, 3-4 derivative posts each): pre-produce weeks 1-2, shoot week 3, post weeks 3-5. Do not use AI-faked celebrity likenesses (California right-of-publicity). Re-editing vault: 2019 vs 2026 diptychs show craft evolution at zero new-shoot cost. Post-30 book tease ushers in book launch (post 31), first testimonial (32), holiday promo (33). Feed ratio post-Shift: 60% craft/client, 20% origin/personal, 20% campaign. Maximum vulnerability posts (7, 13, 18, 25) are plain tiles + long caption, not cinematic reels.

Captions kept to 3-8 sentences max; craft does the screaming
Reply to every comment on posts 1-5 only (trains audience engagement, rest cascades)
No re-hash of archive into portfolio-only feed post-Shift (ratio locks to 60/20/20)

Spec campaigns shoot real models + real locations; AI = storyboarding tool only, not output
Posting times locked: weekday 10am-noon or 7-9pm PT, Saturday 3-6pm, Sunday 8-10pm
Vulnerability posts (25) are factual, not moralized (lost 20K investment, credit drop, called-off wedding are data, not lessons)
Pin strategy rotation prevents feed staleness (post 1 weeks 1-3, strongest performer weeks 4-6, post 30 post-Shift)

weird_gold: The 2019 camera is still in active use as of March 2026 (7 years, same body). Positioning leverage: 'survived robbery, survived every studio era, still the tool.' This is identity lock that's involuntary (not chosen, inherited from necessity).
Clemson apartment one-light origin bridges to current DTLA studio work. Same 'doing more with less' thesis holds; space scaled, concept didn't. Repeatable frame for simplicity marketing.
Amber Lynn 158K followers screenshot is already captured per brain dump. Social proof flywheel unlocked: early talent + current platform = credibility moat.

The JD McCrary session (Dec 11 in brain dump, Dec 24 in Lightroom) used photos over main photographer's work. This is a stealth client-steal story that can anchor premium positioning without naming the main photographer.

Mother's Day campaign uses 'I was never paid for mom's headshots, proudest gig' frame. Inverts typical 'pay me for your mom' into 'mom's portrait is priceless.' Hospitality layer in pricing structure.

Credit score 721 -> under 600 vulnerability is data-heavy, not shame-based. Cleanest way to signal 'building in real time' without apology. Lineage Doctrine alignment: shows the work, not the performance.
Hair transplant + teeth whitening + stem cells trip to Turkey reads as founder-health investment, not vanity. Framing matters for audience interpretation.

Post-Shift ratio (60/20/20) prevents algorithm fatigue. Portfolio posts naturally travel via algorithm; origin/personal viral on engagement; campaign posts drive revenue. Three-lane distribution strategy.

No hashtags on Shift posts forces cold audience + warm audience to the same frame. Reels algorithm favors hashtag-free on high-engagement accounts (Shift trains engagement, then hashtags become redundant).
